rows.name: Endpoint equality as continuity
rows.reason: Equal endpoints and even autonomous reconstruction do not supply strict temporal lineage.

rows.name: Ultimate source and target must share one mixed stage
rows.reason: The rule is not stable under legitimate S-to-M-to-T composition.
rows.replacement: chain of audited atomic overlap legs

rows.name: Holonomy is an endogenous arrow
rows.reason: Noncommuting route structure can coexist with zero endogenous arrow.

rows.name: Externally scheduled activity is target-owned time
rows.reason: The apparent temporal process collapses when scheduler or decoder support is withdrawn.
rows.replacement: target-owned temporal closure and withdrawal autonomy

rows.name: Scalar average defect decides acceptance
rows.reason: Equal or small scalar summaries can hide a failed hard gate.

rows.name: Symmetry selects one unique continuer
rows.reason: A fixed-point-free target swap preserves both valid branches and defeats an invariant singleton selector.

rows.name: Route memory can be erased without flatness
rows.reason: Memory erasure is licensed only by explicit confluence or normalization and zero translation holonomy.
rows.replacement: retain route residue or prove flatness

rows.name: Branchwise preservation implies integrated fusion
rows.reason: Branch marginals do not determine joint recombination or coherent action credit.

rows.name: Arbitrarily long finite success implies unbounded liveness
rows.reason: Every finite horizon has a fail-next countdown; a total invariant policy is separately required.

rows.name: Direct successorship silently broadens strict FIACH
rows.reason: Direct and overlap modes are kept in a broader named path class; strict FIACH remains overlap-only.

rows.name: Temporal-IAPS replaces the surviving primary
rows.reason: Fallback remains typed but inactive because no FIACH kill criterion fired.

rows.name: Carrier polymorphism proves substrate indifference
rows.reason: A2-P and empirical or certificate-soundness bridges remain separate assumptions.
